## Workflow overview

This page will explain the path from recorded EEG data to an interpretable FPVS
response. A complete processing diagram will be added here.

## Data intake and recording checks

This section will cover the information and quality checks needed before
processing begins.

## Preprocessing

This section will describe the preprocessing decisions that should be reported
and justified for an FPVS analysis.

## Segmentation and averaging

This section will explain how continuous recordings are organized for analysis
and how averaging relates to the periodic response.

## Frequency-domain transformation

This section will introduce the transformation from time-domain EEG data to a
frequency-domain representation.

## Response quantification

This section will compare approaches to baseline correction, signal-to-noise
measurement, harmonic selection, and response summarization.

## Quality control and reproducibility

This section will cover visual checks, exclusion decisions, recorded parameters,
and the outputs needed to reproduce an analysis.

## Interpretation and reporting

This section will connect the quantified response to cautious scientific
interpretation and transparent reporting.
